WITH bot_data AS (

        a.accindex,
        sd.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'botlikscore'::text as botlikscore,
        sd.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'autobehavscore'::text as autobehavscore,
        ma.convnatval
    FROM account a
    LEFT JOIN profile p ON a.accindex = p.profaccref
    LEFT JOIN sessionbehavior sb ON p.profkey = sb.sessprofref
    LEFT JOIN networkmetrics nm ON sb.sessref = nm.netsessref
    LEFT JOIN technicalinfo t ON nm.netkey = t.technetref
    LEFT JOIN securitydetection sd ON t.techkey = sd.sectechref
    LEFT JOIN messaginganalysis ma ON t.techmsgref = ma.msgkey
    WHERE a.acctstatus = 'Dormant'
)

    accindex,
    ROUND(CAST(
        0.4 * COALESCE(botlikscore::numeric, 0) + 
        0.3 * COALESCE(autobehavscore::numeric, 0) + 
        0.3 * (1 - COALESCE(convnatval, 0))
    AS numeric), 4) as bbi_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN 0.4 * COALESCE(botlikscore::numeric, 0) + 
             0.3 * COALESCE(autobehavscore::numeric, 0) + 
             0.3 * (1 - COALESCE(convnatval, 0)) > 0.9 THEN 'High Risk'
        WHEN 0.4 * COALESCE(botlikscore::numeric, 0) + 
             0.3 * COALESCE(autobehavscore::numeric, 0) + 
             0.3 * (1 - COALESCE(convnatval, 0)) > 0.3 THEN 'Moderate Risk'

        ELSE 3
    END,
    bbi_score DESC;
